This '''Rodian Jedi''' fought alongside both [[Lumas Etima]] and a [[Unidentified Twi'lek Jedi (Geonosis)|Twi'lek Jedi]] at the [[Petranaki arena]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:UnnamedRodianGeonosis.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Lumas Etima, the Rodian Jedi and the Twi'lek Jedi.]] This Rodian Jedi was introduced by [[Hasbro]] in [[2003]], as part of the ''Jedi Knight Army'' multipack. He was later given a full body illustration by [[Jason Edmiston]] for the [[2010]], ''Rodian Jedi & Battle Droid'' multipack. Text included on the back of the 2010 multipack implies that this Rodian survived the Battle of Geonosis.
